nonBlockingObservations.title: Mark the superseded absence wording in the historical r2 table
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The retained r2 changes table still says only a defaulted leaf is absent. The r3 changes table and section 4 explicitly supersede this with no field/no provenance and no Defaulted branch. The current decision is clear, so this is editorial rather than blocking.
